mapper.insert: INSERT INTO BOARD_COMMENT (COMMENT_ID, POST_ID, EMPNO, AUTHOR_NAME, CONTENT, CREATED_AT) VALUES (BOARD_COMMENT_SEQ.NEXTVAL, #{postId}, #{empno}, #{authorName}, #{content}, SYSDATE + 9/24)
mapper.select: SELECT COMMENT_ID, POST_ID, EMPNO, AUTHOR_NAME, CONTENT, TO_CHAR(CREATED_AT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS CREATED_AT FROM BOARD_COMMENT WHERE POST_ID = #{postId} ORDER BY COMMENT_ID ASC
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM BOARD_COMMENT WHERE COMMENT_ID = #{commentId} AND EMPNO = #{empno}
